description: How Earth moves from an iris and an exposed gate room to Prometheus, Ancient defenses, Daedalus-class ships and the Asgard legacy, and why a larger arsenal changes rather than settles the moral stakes.

Antarctic defense and stasis at the end of season seven.
The Antarctic dispute and the System Lords’ recognition of Earth’s Ancient defense.
The allied fleet encounter with the Ori warships at the Supergate.
Carter’s time-dilation intervention, decades aboard Odyssey and Teal’c’s preserved memory.
